description: This file defines the LogFragment class, a subclass of Android's Fragment, which contains and manages a LogView for displaying logs within an Android application. It includes methods to set up the view hierarchy, configure the LogView's appearance, and handle text change events to scroll the log to the bottom.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays logs using a custom LogView, supporting scrolling and text styling.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and constructs the view hierarchy containing a ScrollView and a LogView, setting layout parameters and appearance.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's onCreateView to inflate the views and set a TextWatcher for automatic scrolling.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
